newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inspection destinations for wheat/corn/barley.

text.p: USDA said the 14.529 million bushels wheat, 55.791 million bushels of corn and 38,000 bushels of barley inspected in the week to Nov 14 included the following destinations (1,000 bu):
Gulf to Colombia 255; Dominican Republic 1,032; El Salvador 419; Honduras 337; Israel 1,264; Lesotho 103; Nicaragua 162; Poland 965; Trinidad 410; Venezuela 138.
Pacific to Philippines 1,274; Sri Lanka 1,764; Yemen 1,157; Thailand 883. Interior to Mexico 166.

Gulf to Algeria 1,763; Bulgaria 1,181; Chile 1,214; Colombia 1,549; Dominican Repubic 1,189; Egypt 960; El Salvador 482; Guatemala 633; Jamaica 433; Japan 9,397; Jordan 1,931; South Korea 2,165; Lebanon 911; Malaysia 2,376; Mexico 1,710; Norway 364; Peru 957; Poland 3,694; Trinidad 154; Venezuela 1,430.
Pacific to Taiwan 6,696; Japan 5,414; South Korea 4,320.
